name: the converters write the site's title as it is
why: sa_foreign_mb_titles / sa_foreign_typography on (the default): every converted title goes through _mbSiteTitleText().

name: no tooltip with the site's own text
why: A changed title shows the site's text on hover; the spec reads the cell's tip.

edits.find: if (shown !== text) _setTip(tipEl, `As written on the site:\n${text}`);

name: a setlist row's mixed-case note is rewritten too
why: capsOnly: in a song row only the part in capitals is a title; "(with Patti Scialfa)" must stay as written.

name: the set label is read with the song
why: skipSel leaves span.mb-bb-set-label out; read with it, its mixed case makes the row "not in capitals" and the first song of a labelled set stays in capitals.

name: the year rows' songs are not rewritten at all
why: Soundcheck/Setlist songs go through _mbSiteTitleNodes(); the spec pins "Born in the U.S.A." in a 1985 setlist.

name: the trailing "(THE)" stays
why: brucespringsteen.it's sort form "BOSS AT HIS BEST (THE)" is "The Boss at His Best" in MusicBrainz.

name: a part in capitals inside a mixed title is title-cased
why: "(JEMS)" in a mixed-case jungleland.it title is a name; only a title in capitals outside its parentheses has its parenthesised capitals rewritten.

name: "up" is lower-cased like the other short prepositions
why: On these sites "up" is a verb particle in nearly every title ("Held Up Without a Gun"), which MusicBrainz capitalises.

name: a phrasal "On" is lower-cased
why: "Come On Over", "Bring On the Night": after a verb of _MBTC_PHRASAL the preposition is part of the verb.

name: descriptive extra title information keeps its capitals
why: "(Version 2)" is "(version 2)" in MusicBrainz style; the jungleland.it titles show it in every re-issue.

name: a word led by a digit is capitalised
why: "10TH AVENUE" must become "10th Avenue", not "10Th".

name: an elision's apostrophe opens a quotation
why: "'09", "'Til", "'n'" shorten a word: ’, never ‘.

name: the year rows' songs get no typography
why: The one-for-one punctuation pass runs over a song row's text nodes; the spec pins "I’m on Fire" and the medley's en dash.

name: a song row's "..." is not an ellipsis
why: The length-changing replacements run per text node after the one-for-one pass. No setlist of the five year fixtures holds "..." or "--", so no spec can see this one; the plain-title path (_mbTypography) is pinned by the shared cases.

name: the case setting is not consulted
why: Each setting works alone: with sa_foreign_mb_titles off and typography on, the song list keeps "Born In The U.S.A.".

name: a placeholder in square brackets is title-cased
why: "[no title]" is MusicBrainz's own special-purpose style and stays as written.

name: springsteenlyrics.com card titles are written as the site has them
why: The collection / bootleg / CD and vinyl lists' Title goes through _mbSiteTitleText(); the spec pins "Live at the Matrix".

name: springsteenlyrics.com lyrics titles stay in capitals
why: The lyrics index's Title goes through _mbSetSiteTitle(); the spec pins "Baby Don’t Go".

name: a year page's City and Country stay in capitals
why: City and Country (not USA) are in MusicBrainz style; the spec pins "Hampton" and "Australia".

name: "USA" goes through the title style too
why: The request: leave a Country of "USA" as it is. The explicit exception is belt and braces: USA is also in _MBTC_ACRONYMS, so the title style would keep it anyway and no spec can see this one.
